points.description: States that both iteration and recursion involve repetition (repeating a process/set of statements).
States that both have a termination test (condition that ends the repetition: loop condition / base case).
States that both can occur infinitely (infinite loop / infinite recursion).

rubric.notes: Award each point when the idea is stated in any wording; the three similarities are repetition, termination test, and possible infinite execution. Part marks for a vague or half-stated version (e.g. mentions a stopping condition for only one of them). No marks for differences between iteration and recursion or for unrelated detail, but extra correct detail does no harm.
